title: DEC-301 item 1 build: sign and notarize the Ward release in release.yml (sign job, rehearsal, tests)
description: Builds the accepted design in the Developer ID path reference (WCLI-183, DEC-301 (a3)): a sign job in environment release on a hosted macOS runner that imports the operator-held certificate into a temporary keychain, signs with identifier ai.opum.ward, hardened runtime and timestamp, notarizes with an App Store Connect API key, and verifies; verify, attest (WCLI-109) and release then act on the signed bytes; workflow_dispatch rehearsal from main publishes nothing. No entitlements by default. May be built before any credential exists; it cannot be run until the operator completes steps 1 to 6. Follows WCLI-109 (PR 418) and WCLI-183 (PR 419). Release-path change: own dispatch-floor read and Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release.yml has a sign job, the only job reading the signing secrets, that runs no package manager and deletes its temporary keychain in an always-run step
The signed artifact passes codesign --verify --strict and a designated-requirement check naming the team id and identifier ai.opum.ward before upload
A workflow_dispatch run from main signs and notarizes and publishes nothing; the release job stays tag-only
verify, attest and release need sign and act on the signed bytes
test/release-workflow.test.ts pins the above and the runbooks and ADR 0001 are updated

Also unrun: codesign/notarytool/keychain steps, gh attestation verify, notarytool JSON field names (status, id) and the exact designated-requirement text the check matches.
